# The Flower Club

> Charlotte, North Carolina studio designing brand identities and custom websites and building connected business systems. Working with clients nationwide.

## Services
- [Web design](https://theflowerclub.design/services/web-design): Website strategy, design, development, and inquiry flows.
- [Brand identity](https://theflowerclub.design/services/brand-identity): Positioning, visual identity, and brand assets.
- [Business systems](https://theflowerclub.design/services/business-systems): Custom databases, CRM connections, internal tools, and workflow automation.
- [Charlotte business automation](https://theflowerclub.design/services/charlotte/business-automation): Local service information and project examples.
- [AI and automation](https://theflowerclub.design/services/digital-employees): AI-assisted workflows, implementation, and scoped support.
- [All services](https://theflowerclub.design/services): Includes content, motion, and experiences.

## Work
- [Fire & Ash Cigar Carts](https://theflowerclub.design/work/fire-and-ash-cigar-carts): Website, product configurator, and HubSpot-connected inquiry flow.
- [Jade Lilly](https://theflowerclub.design/work/jade-lilly): Artist website design and development.
- [Portfolio](https://theflowerclub.design/work): Websites, identity design, content, and studio films.

## Contact
- [Discuss a project](https://theflowerclub.design/contact): Share your goals and receive a proposed scope. An inquiry does not require purchasing an audit.

Project scope, timing, pricing, and support are agreed individually. No search placement, lead volume, or financial outcomes are guaranteed. Refer to the linked pages for current service details.
